deviations.trigger: Activating T-04 package manifests creates lock importers, and wiring the root compatibility facades through public package exports requires matching root workspace:* declarations under the T-03 dependency and lock gates; the original T-04 path contract treated both root files as T-03-owned.
deviations.decision: T-03 retains workspace, catalog, root dependency and lock policy ownership. T-04 may add only workspace:* declarations for T-04 packages actually imported by its root facades, the matching root lock specifiers, and mechanically generated importers for T-04 manifests. Root scripts, catalogs, external versions, unrelated dependencies and existing resolutions remain read-only.
deviations.verification: Lead candidate must inspect the structured lock diff and pass frozen install, architecture tests and the full Gate D suite.

deviations.trigger: The platform/app-runtime placeholder explicitly activates with the demo pilot, while activating the demo domain/web-domain and root compatibility facades creates internal dependency declarations and lock importers outside the original T-05 writable paths.
deviations.decision: T-05 owns packages/platform/app-runtime and may add only workspace:* declarations for T-05 packages actually consumed by root compatibility facades, matching root lock specifiers, and importers mechanically generated from T-05 manifests. T-03 retains workspace/catalog/root dependency/lock policy ownership; root scripts, catalogs, external versions, unrelated dependencies, workspace config, existing resolutions, and global permission/router/store remain read-only.
deviations.verification: Lead candidate must inspect structured manifest/lock diff and pass registry reverse fixtures, frozen install, architecture tests, admin build, and required demo route E2E.

deviations.trigger: The engineering CRUD target requires POST mutations, but this change explicitly excludes backend API changes while existing demo update/delete endpoints use PUT/DELETE and must remain compatible during architectural extraction.
deviations.decision: T-05 preserves only the existing demo paths and PUT/DELETE methods. It may not introduce new non-POST mutation endpoints or unilaterally change transport. The compatibility exception expires after a coordinated backend method migration updates all consumers.
deviations.verification: Domain transport tests must lock the pre-existing paths/methods, candidate E2E must prove compatibility, and Evidence must record the expiration condition.

deviations.trigger: A pre-created demo/missing facade can exercise the registry diagnostic adapter, but the T-07-owned legacy global views glob returns undefined before a genuinely unknown backend component key can reach that adapter.
deviations.decision: T-05 proves registry missing diagnostics, valid demo facade compose-resolve-load integration, an explicitly named diagnostic harness, and keep-alive. AC-012's generic fail-visible behavior remains unchanged and is assigned to T-07, which must test a typo key with no physical facade while integrating the global permission/router path. T-05 may not modify those protected paths or claim its sentinel as generic proof.
deviations.verification: T-05 E2E names and Evidence must identify the explicit harness; T-07 Gate G1 must use a backend typo component key with no matching facade and prove a visible App/domain/key diagnostic.

deviations.trigger: Activating package manifests under apps/client-web, domains/identity-access, web-domains/identity-access, or web-kit requires matching pnpm lockfile importers, while T-03 owns lock policy.
deviations.decision: T-06 may write only new pnpm-lock importers and specifiers mechanically generated from package manifests inside its writable directories. Root package/scripts, workspace/catalog policy, external versions, existing importers/resolutions, and unrelated lock nodes remain read-only.
deviations.verification: Lead candidate must inspect the structured lock diff and pass frozen install, workspace list, architecture tests, dual-App builds, and required client-web E2E.

deviations.trigger: Activating platform/permission and routing root auth/menu/store/view compatibility facades through public packages requires matching root internal dependency declarations and pnpm lock importer updates outside the original T-07 writable paths.
deviations.decision: T-07 may add only workspace:* declarations for identity-access, web-domain-identity-access, and platform-permission packages actually consumed by root compatibility facades, matching root lock specifiers, the platform-permission importer, and mechanical importer updates from T-07 writable manifests. T-03 retains root dependency, workspace, catalog, and lock policy ownership; root scripts, external versions, existing resolutions, and unrelated lock nodes remain read-only.
deviations.verification: Lead candidate must inspect structured manifest/lock diffs and pass frozen install, workspace list, architecture tests, dual-App builds, and required auth/router E2E.

deviations.trigger: The T-01 migration characterization asserts that login immediately sends /auth/login, while T-07 AC-015 requires validated ClientContext before any authentication request.
deviations.decision: T-07 may update src/utils/request.test.ts only to replace the legacy direct-login characterization with context-code-login ordering and add the session mocks required by compatibility facades. Production src/utils/request.ts remains read-only, and existing header, 401 singleton, download, and error-safety assertions may not be removed or weakened.
deviations.verification: Targeted tests must prove Client validation and request ordering while all unaffected request/401 characterization tests remain green.

deviations.trigger: T-08 must prove that admin explicitly selects the workflow definition manifest, while the only admin composition point is T-07-owned and activating the two workflow packages requires root dependency and lock importer updates owned by T-03 policy.
deviations.decision: T-08 may modify src/router/adminManifestRegistry.ts only to add workflow domain/manifest inputs and selected IDs. It may add only the two actually consumed workflow workspace:* root dependencies, matching root lock specifiers, and mechanically generated importers for packages/domains/workflow and packages/web-domains/workflow. Resolver and route-assembler semantics, identity/demo inputs and selection, root scripts, workspace/catalog policy, external versions, existing resolutions, and unrelated lock nodes remain read-only.
deviations.verification: Lead candidate must inspect structured composition/manifest/lock diffs and pass selected/unselected manifest tests, frozen install, workspace list, architecture tests, dual-App builds, and required workflow definition E2E.

deviations.trigger: The engineering CRUD target requires POST mutations, but backend API changes are outside this change and the existing workflow category, definition, and SpEL controllers expose PUT and DELETE mutation contracts consumed by the current frontend.
deviations.decision: T-08 must preserve the existing workflow category, definition, and SpEL paths and HTTP methods exactly, including PUT and DELETE. It may not invent parallel endpoints or unilaterally migrate transport. This compatibility exception expires only after a coordinated backend method migration updates every consumer.
deviations.verification: Domain transport tests must lock all migrated paths and methods, candidate E2E must exercise representative mutations, and Evidence must record the expiration condition.

deviations.trigger: DEV-T08-001 requires proof that admin selects workflow definition registrations without selecting T-09 runtime registrations, but the existing exact admin registry unit path remains T-07-owned and was not included in the original T-08 writable list.
deviations.decision: T-08 may modify src/router/adminManifestRegistry.test.ts only to append assertions for selected workflow definition keys and an unselected workflow runtime key. Existing identity/demo assertions, test infrastructure, production resolver behavior, and every other router test remain read-only.
deviations.verification: Lead review must confirm the test diff is assertion-only within the allowed workflow scope and the full root unit suite remains green.

deviations.trigger: T-08 used four candidate integration attempts, exceeding the Goal Plan default maximum of three, because successive required E2E runs exposed a hidden native checkbox locator, a SpEL mutation completion race, and two missing live dictionary fixtures.
deviations.decision: The first three candidates did not advance the parent. Each finding was fixed in the source worktree by an append-only commit, passed both review axes, and was integrated into a newly rebuilt candidate. Attempt four passed the full Gate and may be promoted. For later Tickets, a third failed candidate requires an explicit stop, deviation record, and root-cause review before any fourth attempt.
deviations.verification: Evidence must enumerate all four attempts, prove the parent stayed at the prior result through attempts one to three, and record the final full-suite and 18/18 Playwright result.

deviations.trigger: T-09 requires workflow to consume a minimum system-admin/public/user contract through a legal package export, but packages/domains/system-admin is still a README-only placeholder and the original writable paths did not include package activation or lock importer changes.
deviations.decision: T-09 may activate @namewta/domain-system-admin by changing only its README.md, package.json, tsconfig.json, and public/user subtree; add the workspace:* dependency only to the writable workflow package manifest; and mechanically add only the system-admin lock importer and workflow dependency specifier. Root package/scripts, admin registry, workspace/catalog policy, external versions, existing resolutions, and unrelated lock nodes remain read-only. T-10 owns all later system-admin implementation and must preserve this public seam.
deviations.verification: Lead candidate must inspect structured package/lock diffs and pass frozen install, workspace and architecture checks, no-deep/no-cycle tests, dual builds, and required workflow runtime E2E.

deviations.trigger: Fixed-point dual-axis review found that complete workflow parity requires host-owned FileUpload and current-tab closing capabilities that are not available inside web-domain-workflow, while the original T-09 contract kept the admin composition path read-only.
deviations.decision: T-09 may modify src/router/adminManifestRegistry.ts only to inject the existing root FileUpload component and a closeCurrentPage host port into WorkflowWebRuntime and expose that same composed workflow runtime for src/components/Process compatibility facades. The root upload implementation, resolver and route-assembler semantics, existing manifest selection, root manifest/lock, external versions, and all other host behavior remain read-only. The source must also restore instance variable updates, timestamp-range leave dates with computed days, completion navigation, cancellation message, true Process facades, comma-separated scalar userIds candidate queries, an admin-intervention action policy independent from participant buttonList, and matching UI/E2E coverage; a manual attachment-ID field, all-buttons-visible fixture, or README claim is not parity.
deviations.verification: Both review axes must pass at a new fixed commit. Lead candidate must exercise complete/back attachment upload, instance variable update, leave add/start/approval completion, cancellation message, delegate/transfer/add-sign/reduce-sign/back, compatibility facades, exact scalar userIds query with a forbidden candidate fixture, and admin intervention when participant buttons are hidden before Gate G3.

deviations.trigger: After submitVerify and processMeddle became facades, migrating the remaining approval, history, and chart Process components without a reverse app import requires host-owned chart URL, OSS metadata resolution, and attachment download capabilities.
deviations.decision: T-09 may add only chartUrl, resolveAttachments, and downloadAttachment host ports to WorkflowWebRuntime and the existing admin composition point, then migrate the remaining six Process components into web-domain-workflow public exports and turn every src/components/Process path into a compatibility facade. Root auth, OSS, and download implementations, manifest and resolver semantics, and all other runtime behavior remain read-only.
deviations.verification: Architecture and no-deep-import checks, legacy props/events/exposes, root and workspace typecheck/lint/unit, dual builds, and review of all eight facade files must pass before Gate G3.

deviations.trigger: T-09 reached three candidate integration attempts. Progressive browser runs exposed a missing client-web 4174 environment, Element Plus locator ambiguity and fixture gaps, then a production same-tick reactive-prop race in candidate filtering plus repeat-submit protection on an unchanged immediate retry.
deviations.decision: Attempts one through three did not advance the parent and every transient candidate was removed. A fourth attempt is allowed only after source-only fixes add a Vue nextTick boundary before opening UserSelect, scope the duplicate error locator, and prove failed back input remains editable before retrying with a changed message; both review axes must pass at the new source checkpoint. The fourth candidate must start from the unchanged parent, run the targeted 11 workflow tests before the full 29-test dual-App suite, and pass the complete Gate before promotion.
deviations.verification: Evidence must enumerate attempt one (full non-browser Gate passed; full browser 18/29 with client-web 4174 absent and workflow failures), attempt two (targeted workflow 6/11), attempt three (targeted workflow 8/11), prove main remained 262c06d38be0d123e4ec07d8905fc13f87a8fcab throughout, and record fourth-attempt targeted, full-suite, full-Gate, candidate and result SHAs.

deviations.trigger: Activating domain-system-admin beyond its T-09 public seam and activating web-domain-system-admin require lock importer updates; root compatibility facades and the only admin selected-only composition point require matching root workspace dependencies and scoped registry wiring outside the original T-10 writable paths.
deviations.decision: T-10 may add only @namewta/domain-system-admin and @namewta/web-domain-system-admin workspace:* declarations actually consumed by root compatibility facades or admin composition, matching root lock specifiers, and importers mechanically generated from the two T-10 package manifests. It may modify src/router/adminManifestRegistry.ts only to add the system-admin domain/manifest, selected IDs, and the minimum typed host runtime ports required by the migrated seven slices; existing identity/demo/workflow composition, resolver behavior, global permission, workspace/catalog policy, root scripts, external versions, existing resolutions, and unrelated lock nodes remain read-only. It may modify src/router/adminManifestRegistry.test.ts only to append system-admin selected registrations and a client/unselected boundary assertion without weakening existing assertions.
deviations.verification: Lead must inspect structured root manifest/lock diffs, every new registry port and assertion, prove the public/user subtree is byte-identical to the T-09 result, and pass frozen install, workspace/architecture, no-deep/no-cycle, dual builds, existing registry tests, workflow regression, and required T-10 E2E before Gate G4.

deviations.trigger: The engineering CRUD target prefers POST mutations, but backend changes are outside this change and the existing client, user, userType, role, menu, department, and post controllers expose PUT and DELETE contracts already consumed by the frontend.
deviations.decision: T-10 must preserve every existing path and HTTP method exactly, including PUT and DELETE mutations. It may not invent parallel endpoints or unilaterally normalize transport. This compatibility exception expires only after a coordinated backend migration updates the controllers and every frontend consumer.
deviations.verification: Domain transport tests must enumerate the migrated seven-slice method/path matrix, candidate E2E must exercise representative create/update/delete and authorization paths, and Evidence must record the compatibility expiration condition.

deviations.trigger: Manifest-loaded system resource pages require existing host-owned dict cache mutation, OSS download, HTML/content security utilities, and Editor/ImagePreview components; direct root imports or local duplication would violate the package boundary or weaken established behavior. The existing registry test also intentionally marks system/oss as unselected until T-11.
deviations.decision: T-11 may modify src/router/adminManifestRegistry.ts only to append typed SystemAdminWebRuntime ports backed by the existing dict store, OSS download plugin, sanitizeHtml/replaceOssContentUrls utilities, and read-only Editor/ImagePreview components. It may modify src/router/adminManifestRegistry.test.ts only to replace the prior system/oss unselected fixture with selected system resource registrations and an unrelated unselected assertion. Domain/manifest IDs, existing selected IDs, resolver behavior, other host ports, global router/request/App, root manifest/lock, shared component implementations, identity and devtools remain read-only.
deviations.verification: Lead must inspect the exact registry/test diff, prove no root security/component implementation changed, run existing sanitize/request/OSS/upload tests, selected-only registry tests, frozen install, full architecture/lint/type/test/build, and required T-11 E2E before Gate G5.

deviations.trigger: During attempt-1 candidate setup, the fast-forward command ran in the parent checkout instead of the new candidate worktree. Lead detected it before validation, moved the candidate ref to source, restored main to the exact expected parent with an old-value-guarded ref update, and revalidated both clean worktrees. The corrected candidate then passed the non-browser Gate but targeted E2E exposed an unrealistic top-level menu fixture and an inaccessible dialog-name locator.
deviations.decision: Attempt 1 is retained as a failed candidate and may not promote. Source and candidate refs preserve every commit; main must remain at 9ce426c20be49209d24b40083e14eede4ea31109 until a rebuilt candidate passes. T-11 may change only its dedicated E2E fixture to use a real Layout parent with child routes and to locate the titleless Element Plus confirmation dialog by role plus visible message text. Production behavior and assertions for message consumption, upload/download, Client headers, social failure, permissions, strict unknown requests and client exclusion may not be weakened.
deviations.verification: The append-only source fix must pass both review axes. Attempt 2 must be rebuilt from unchanged main, rerun the full non-browser Gate, all four T-11 browser tests and the full dual-App Playwright suite before promotion. Evidence must retain the temporary ref correction and attempt-1 2/4 result.

deviations.trigger: T-11 reached three failed candidates without advancing main. Attempt 2 closed the original fixture problems but exposed a real icon-only OSS action without an accessible name. After that production accessibility fix passed both review axes, attempt 3 reached the upload terminal state and strict-unknown assertion, which exposed two legitimate follow-up requests missing from the dedicated fixture: GET /system/dict/data/list and GET /resource/oss/listByIds/8.
deviations.decision: Attempts 1 through 3 remain failed and no candidate may promote. A fourth attempt is allowed only after an append-only source commit changes e2e/system-resources.spec.ts to fulfill the existing dict-data list request and the uploaded OSS listByIds/8 lookup with concrete projected data, records both as admin Client-scoped requests, and keeps strict unknown equal to empty. No production file, locator, permission, endpoint, assertion strength or unrelated fixture may change. Both independent review axes must pass at the new fixed commit. Attempt 4 must be rebuilt from unchanged main, run the full non-browser Gate, targeted T-11 4/4, then the complete dual-App Playwright suite before promotion.
deviations.verification: Evidence must retain all three failed attempt results, prove main remained 9ce426c20be49209d24b40083e14eede4ea31109 and every transient candidate was removed, and show the fourth candidate's exact source/tree, full Gate, targeted 4/4, full dual-App count and final promotion result.

deviations.trigger: Attempt 4 passed the complete non-browser Gate but targeted Playwright was 3/4 because a page-wide exact filename locator matched the upload dialog and background OSS list at once. Main remained at 9ce426c20be49209d24b40083e14eede4ea31109 and the transient candidate was removed. The configured attempt limit of 4 prevented another source fix and candidate.
deviations.decision: The user explicitly authorizes raising both Speculo config max_integration_attempts and the Goal Plan integration_attempt_limit from 4 to 5. T-11 may change only e2e/system-resources.spec.ts to scope the file input and pre-confirm filename assertion to the real upload dialog. The post-confirm list assertion, upload transfer/complete/listByIds facts, Client method/path facts, permissions and strict-unknown assertion must remain strong. Attempt 5 must use a new fixed source reviewed on both axes and a candidate rebuilt from unchanged main.
deviations.verification: The source fix must pass both review axes. Attempt 5 must pass the full non-browser Gate, targeted T-11 4/4 and the complete dual-App Playwright suite before parent promotion; Evidence must retain attempt 4 and show exact source/candidate/result SHAs.

deviations.trigger: At fixed point cfc09f4, the specification axis passed but the standards axis found that the post-confirm page-wide filename .first() could match the closing upload dialog and falsely pass without proving the OSS table refresh.
deviations.decision: T-11 may strengthen only e2e/system-resources.spec.ts by recording the OSS list request count before confirm, waiting for the upload dialog to become hidden, waiting for exactly one additional OSS list request, and asserting the uploaded filename inside an OSS table row. Production code and the existing transfer, complete, listByIds, Client method/path, permission and strict-unknown assertions remain unchanged.
deviations.verification: The new source fixed point must pass both independent review axes before the already authorized fifth candidate. Candidate verification remains full non-browser Gate, targeted T-11 4/4 and complete dual-App Playwright.

deviations.trigger: Attempt 5 passed the complete non-browser Gate but targeted Playwright was 3/4 because the real upload dialog itself renders two links with the uploaded filename; the dialog-scoped exact-text locator still violated strict mode before confirm. Main remained at 9ce426c20be49209d24b40083e14eede4ea31109 and the transient candidate was removed. The configured attempt limit of 5 prevented another source fix and candidate.
deviations.decision: The user explicitly authorizes raising both Speculo config max_integration_attempts and the Goal Plan integration_attempt_limit from 5 to 6. T-11 may change only the pre-confirm filename assertion in e2e/system-resources.spec.ts to select one link with the exact accessible name inside the upload dialog. The post-confirm dialog-hidden, exact list refresh, OSS table row, upload transfer/complete/listByIds, Client method/path, permission and strict-unknown assertions must remain strong. Attempt 6 must use a new fixed source reviewed on both axes and a candidate rebuilt from unchanged main.
deviations.verification: The source fix must pass both review axes. Attempt 6 must pass the full non-browser Gate, targeted T-11 4/4 and the complete dual-App Playwright suite before parent promotion; Evidence must retain attempt 5 and show exact source/candidate/result SHAs.

deviations.trigger: The operations packages are README-only placeholders without lock importers, root compatibility facades require declared workspace dependencies, and the adminManifestRegistry is the only selected composition point for operations pages and their host-owned iframe/environment capabilities.
deviations.decision: T-14 may add only @namewta/domain-operations and @namewta/web-domain-operations workspace:* root dependencies, matching root lock specifiers, and the two manifests' mechanically generated importers. It may modify src/router/adminManifestRegistry.ts only to append the operations domain/manifest, selected IDs, and minimum typed request/modal/download/permission/IFrame plus VITE_APP_MONITOR_ADMIN, VITE_APP_SNAILJOB_ADMIN and VITE_APP_SNAILAI_ADMIN host values; URL validation and navigation intent remain owned by operations. The registry test may only append selected operations and unrelated unselected assertions. Existing composition/resolver/router/request/App, platform/identity, scripts/catalog/external versions/resolutions and unrelated lock nodes remain read-only.
deviations.verification: Lead must inspect structured manifest/lock and additive registry diffs, run unsafe-URL/permission/API-failure negative tests, frozen install, workspace/architecture/no-deep/no-cycle, dual builds, selected-only registry tests, and required operations E2E before Gate G6.

deviations.trigger: The AI packages are README-only placeholders without lock importers, root facades and admin composition require declared workspace dependencies, and adminManifestRegistry is the only selected composition point for the AI chat page and host-owned credential/base URL values.
deviations.decision: T-12 may add only @namewta/domain-ai and @namewta/web-domain-ai workspace:* root dependencies, matching root lock specifiers, and the two manifests' mechanically generated importers. It may modify src/router/adminManifestRegistry.ts only to append the AI domain/manifest, selected IDs, and minimum typed root request plus trusted credential/base URL runtime ports. The registry test may only append the ai/chat/index selected assertion and an unrelated unselected assertion. Existing composition/resolver/router/request/App, platform/identity, scripts/catalog/external versions/resolutions and unrelated lock nodes remain read-only; client-web remains unchanged and unselected.
deviations.verification: Lead must inspect structured manifest/lock and additive registry diffs, prove credential values are not logged, run frozen install, workspace/architecture/no-deep/no-cycle, dual builds, selected-only registry tests, and required AI E2E before Gate G5.

deviations.trigger: The fixed base contains only POST /snail-ai/user/register and the ai/chat/index embedded Snail AI iframe. The prior custom frontend streaming implementation was removed; there is no current Fetch, SSE, ReadableStream, prompt, or stream retry contract to migrate.
deviations.decision: T-12 interprets the planned stream lifecycle as the existing embedded-chat lifecycle: registration request, trusted credential URL construction through explicit Web runtime values, iframe load/error completion, credential-bearing URL cleanup, and user retry. It must preserve the current endpoint, component key and empty permission contribution, must not invent or restore a deleted stream transport, and must not log prompt/token/credential material.
deviations.verification: Domain tests must lock the single registration endpoint and concrete user result; Web tests/E2E must prove missing credential, registration failure, iframe error, URL cleanup/retry, selected admin and unselected client behavior without exposing credential values in diagnostics.

deviations.trigger: Fixed-point dual-axis review proved that browser iframe error events cannot reliably represent failed navigation. A real same-origin embedded-document probe requires one new typed host runtime port and adapter tests in the only admin composition point, beyond DEV-T12-001's selected/unselected assertion-only registry allowance.
deviations.decision: T-12 may add only an abortable same-origin GET probeFrame port to AiWebRuntime, implement it in src/router/adminManifestRegistry.ts with redirect rejection plus successful HTML content validation, and add focused adapter tests in src/router/adminManifestRegistry.test.ts. The session must validate a root-relative base path before registration, publish no credential-bearing iframe URL until the probe succeeds, clear it on timeout/dispose, and use the existing repeatSubmit:false request capability for immediate retry. This supersedes DEV-T12-002 only where it named iframe error as the failure signal; it does not authorize a new backend, postMessage, SSE, router, resolver, selection, credential logging, or other registry behavior.
deviations.verification: Lead must inspect the exact registry/test diff, prove all probe URLs are same-origin root-relative and credentials are absent from diagnostics, run adapter/session timeout-abort-retry tests, full Gate, and required E2E with a real aborted/failed probe followed by immediate successful retry and terminal iframe load.

deviations.trigger: The devtools placeholders have no lock importers or root composition, codegen requires the /system/dict/type/optionselect catalog that T-11's value-only public dict port cannot expose, and the existing GET ZIP helper accepts HTML or truncated error bodies and logs raw transport errors. Direct system internals or the unsafe legacy helper would violate T-13's public-seam and no-corrupt-download contracts.
deviations.decision: After T-11 is integrated, T-13 may add only @namewta/domain-devtools and @namewta/web-domain-devtools workspace:* root dependencies, matching root lock specifiers and two mechanical importers; domain-devtools may declare @namewta/domain-system-admin workspace:* and consume only its public entries. It may extend packages/domains/system-admin/public/dict/** only with a projected dict-type catalog port for the existing /system/dict/type/optionselect endpoint, without exposing system DTOs or changing existing get(type). It may modify src/router/adminManifestRegistry.ts/test only to append devtools domain/manifest, selected IDs and minimum typed request/modal/navigation/client/menu/dict/downloadZip ports plus selected/unselected assertions. It may harden only src/plugins/download.ts zip behavior and a focused test so GET ZIP accepts a validated ZIP response, never saves JSON/HTML/plain/truncated payloads, closes loading in finally and emits sanitized user errors without raw console logging. Existing generic request/axios adapter, OSS download, resolver/router/App, other system code, client-web, scripts/catalog/external versions/resolutions and unrelated lock nodes remain read-only.
deviations.verification: Lead must inspect structured package/lock and exact public-dict/registry/plugin diffs; prove no system deep import or cycle, preserve the existing dict value port and legacy ZIP endpoint/method/filename, run ZIP negative unit tests for JSON/HTML/plain/truncated/network failures with zero save and no raw diagnostics, full Gate and required preview/valid-download/failure/client-exclusion E2E before Gate G6.

deviations.trigger: T-13 reached three failed candidate checks while main remained at 8144f98bd8a005c1386e7de8462fd354776b5d34. Attempt 1 passed the full non-browser Gate but targeted Playwright was 2/5 because three locators did not match the real Element Plus DOM. Attempt 2 was 4/5 after those fixes and exposed hidden historical select options. Attempt 3 was 4/5 after visible-dropdown scoping but bound an outgoing popper during its transition. During attempt 1 setup, a fast-forward command also briefly targeted the clean parent checkout; Lead detected it before validation, restored main with an expected-old ref guard, restored the parent index/worktree to the verified base, and rebuilt the candidate in the correct worktree.
deviations.decision: All three transient candidates are removed and none is an accepted parent result. Under the user-authorized integration limit of six, attempt 4 is allowed only after the source E2E resolves each option through the clicked combobox's aria-controls listbox rather than page-wide, hidden, indexed, or transition-sensitive locators. Production code, option names/actions, complete update/params/columns payload, metadata Client IDs, ZIP zero-save, retry/race, client exclusion, and strict-unknown assertions remain unchanged. The new source checkpoint must pass both review axes; attempt 4 must be rebuilt from unchanged main and pass the full non-browser Gate, targeted 5/5, and full dual-App Playwright before promotion.
deviations.verification: Evidence must enumerate attempts 1-3, the immediate parent-ref correction, clean parent 8144f98 throughout, transient cleanup, the aria-controls locator fixed point and dual PASS, then record attempt 4 full Gate, targeted and full Playwright results before any parent update.

deviations.trigger: Attempt 4 passed the complete non-browser Gate but targeted Playwright remained 4/5 because clicking the Element Plus combobox input was intercepted by its placeholder before the aria-controls listbox lookup. The candidate did not advance main and was removed; main remains clean at 8144f98bd8a005c1386e7de8462fd354776b5d34.
deviations.decision: Within the existing user-authorized limit of six, T-13 may change only the E2E helper's open action to click the owning test-id select container, which is the interaction already proven to open all four selects, while continuing to read aria-controls from its child combobox and preserving exact listbox ID, role/name option click, Escape/hidden convergence, and every payload and failure assertion. The new source must pass both review axes; attempt 5 must be rebuilt from unchanged main and pass the complete non-browser Gate, targeted 5/5, and full dual-App Playwright before promotion.
deviations.verification: Lead must confirm the source delta is the single helper click target, both reviewers PASS the same fixed point, and attempt 5 provides all final Gate and browser evidence before parent update.

deviations.trigger: Attempt 5 passed the complete non-browser Gate and the aria-controls listbox flow, but targeted Playwright remained 4/5 when the later tree radio input was intercepted by Element Plus's visible radio wrapper. The candidate was removed without advancing clean main 8144f98bd8a005c1386e7de8462fd354776b5d34.
deviations.decision: The sixth and final candidate allowed by the user-authorized integration limit may be attempted only after the T-13 E2E clicks the label.el-radio wrapper containing the accessible tree radio and then explicitly asserts that radio is checked. Production code and every existing listbox, payload, metadata, ZIP zero-save, retry/race, client exclusion, and strict-unknown assertion remain unchanged. The new fixed point requires both review axes and attempt 6 must pass the complete non-browser Gate, targeted 5/5, and full dual-App Playwright before promotion; any failure stops execution at the configured limit.
deviations.verification: Lead must confirm the source delta only replaces the intercepted radio-input click with its owning label plus checked terminal assertion, obtain dual PASS, and record all attempt 6 Gate/browser/parent facts.

deviations.trigger: Attempt 6 passed the complete non-browser Gate but targeted Playwright remained 4/5. The tree radio wrapper click and checked assertion succeeded; the next locator waited for getByTestId('tree-root-value').locator('input') until the 30-second timeout. The captured accessibility snapshot proves the tree fields and textbox named 根节点值 with value 0 were rendered, so the failure is an invalid test-id assumption rather than missing production UI.
